rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone who is not old enough, including for a particular activity.

example.english: They are underage, so the bar will not let them in.
example.traditional: 佢未夠秤，酒吧唔畀佢入。
example.jyutping: keoi5 mei6 gau3 cing3 zau2 baa1 m4 bei2 keoi5 jap6

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that someone is legally a minor rather than merely too young for one activity.

example.english: They are still underage and cannot sign this contract on their own.
example.traditional: 佢仲未成年，唔可以自己簽呢份合約。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zung6 mei6 sing4 nin4 m4 ho2 ji5 zi6 gei2 cim1 ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3
